what: DOS device driver for the first CONFIG.SYS line: sets CR0 = 10h (clears CD/NW cache-disable and other bits left set by modern CSM/CSMWrap firmware), CR2 = CR3 = CR4 = 0, EFER = 0, then unloads. Needed before Windows 9x SETUP.EXE, which starts its own mini-Windows without WIN.COM, so Patcher9x's WIN.COM register cleanup does not cover it.
